answer: Non-parallelizable sequential context chains. Each agent maintains a private dialogue log with random peers; every new message must extend the unique prior thread within 90 seconds, then hash the chain into an opal-sealed commitment on the public atlas. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must produce distinct continuous original histories for each, which cannot be cheaply parallelized, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. Even at network nadir the sequential dependency forces linear effort per identity.
